summary.goal: Audit log showing all events in chronological order. Enables post-run debugging, retrospective analysis, and compliance auditing.

acceptance_criteria.description: Chronological list of all run events with timestamps (HH:MM:SS format)
Event types with icons: task lifecycle, agent events, gate events
Filter by event type (tasks, agents, gates, all)
Export log button (JSON or CSV)
Artifact references as clickable links in timeline entries
Visual indicators for run start/end

observations: Timeline pulls from trajectory capture in forge-core
Virtualization needed for long timelines (>100 events)
patterns: Event type filtering via tabs or dropdown

virtualization.rationale: Modern, well-maintained, React 18 compatible, better than react-window for this use case
virtualization.row_height: Fixed height per event type for smooth scrolling

steps.title: Create timeline API module
steps.description: API functions for fetching timeline events

acceptance_criteria.description: getRunTimeline(runId, filter?: { type?: string }) returns { events: TimelineEvent[] }
TimelineEvent type: { event_id, run_id, event_type, timestamp, data, task_id?, agent_id? }

Event types: run_started, run_completed, run_failed, task_started, task_completed, task_failed, agent_spawned, agent_exited, gate_reached, gate_approved, gate_rejected, question_asked, question_answered

steps.title: Create TimelineEvent component
steps.description: Single event row in the timeline with fixed height for virtualization

acceptance_criteria.description: Timestamp in HH:MM:SS format (relative to run start)
Event type icon with color coding
Event description with context (task title, agent name, etc.)
Expandable details section for complex events
Artifact links if event has associated artifacts
Fixed height: 56px collapsed, 120px expanded (for virtualization)

design.layout: flex items-start gap-4 p-3 border-l-2 border-border-subtle hover:bg-bg-tertiary

acceptance_criteria.description: Dropdown or tabs: All, Tasks, Agents, Gates, Questions
Filter persists to URL params
Count badges showing number of events per type

steps.title: Create TimelineList component with virtualization
steps.description: Virtualized scrollable list of timeline events

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders TimelineEvent for each event
Visual marker for run start (top) and run end (bottom if completed)
Auto-scrolls to latest event for running runs
Virtualized rendering when events.length > 100
Uses @tanstack/react-virtual for virtualization
Smooth scrolling with fixed row heights

design.layout: relative pl-4 ml-4 (vertical line on left)

steps.title: Create ExportButton component
steps.description: Button to export timeline as JSON or CSV

acceptance_criteria.description: Dropdown button: Export JSON, Export CSV
JSON export: full event data
CSV export: timestamp, type, description, task_id, agent_id
Downloads file with filename: forge-run-{runId}-timeline.{ext}

specification.pattern: Client-side export using Blob and download link

steps.title: Create useTimeline hook
steps.description: Data fetching hook for timeline events

acceptance_criteria.description: useTimeline(runId, filter) returns { events, isLoading, error }
For running runs: SSE subscription for new events
Appends new events to existing list (no full refetch)
Client-side filtering when filter changes (no API refetch for type filter)

architecture.pattern: Initial fetch + SSE append for running runs
architecture.optimization: Client-side filtering to avoid API calls

acceptance_criteria.description: Header with breadcrumb: Forge > Run [id] > Timeline
Back button to return to dashboard
TimelineFilter and ExportButton in toolbar
TimelineList as main content
Loading state: skeleton timeline entries
Empty state: 'No events recorded yet'

design.toolbar: flex justify-between items-center p-4 border-b border-border-subtle

steps.title: Add artifact links
steps.description: Make artifact references clickable in timeline

acceptance_criteria.description: Detect artifact references in event data
Render as external links (target='_blank')
Icon indicates type: GitHubIcon for PRs/commits, LinkIcon for deployments
Copy link button on hover
